# easydns_parsed_records (Data Source)

Returns records as they appear after EasyDNS expands custom stored values. A single stored record ID can appear more than once when it expands to multiple zone-file records.

```terraform
data "easydns_parsed_records" "current" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "expanded_urls" {
  value = [for record in data.easydns_parsed_records.current.records : record.url if record.url != ""]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain whose parsed records are returned.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) Parsed zone records. One stored record ID may produce multiple parsed entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `geozone_id` (Number) EasyDNS geo-region ID.
- `host` (String) Parsed record host.
- `id` (String) EasyDNS stored record ID.
- `last_mod` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `orig_rdata` (String) Original stored rdata before EasyDNS parsing.
- `prio` (Number) Record priority.
- `rdata` (String) Parsed record data.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds.
- `type` (String) Parsed record type.
- `url` (String) Original URL target for EasyDNS custom URL records.
